data.title: Panel: validated typed values, throttled slider drags, collapsible Jitter

fields.actions: Panel interaction pass: (1) typed value boxes validate on every keystroke (empty / NaN / out of live bounds / non-integer seed) and only highlight in place with a bounds hint — the model keeps its committed value; Enter or blur with a valid value commits, Escape or an invalid blur reverts; arrow keys step live. (2) Slider and label-scrub drags go through a drag scheduler (controls.js createDragScheduler): live recompiles throttled to 1.5× the measured compile time (50–350 ms), a pause always flushes, heavy configs compile only on pause, release commits. (3) Jitter cluster is collapsible (folded by default, persisted in shapemaker.groups.open) with an amount/direction summary in the header. (4) Fixed-width value column so readout↔editor swaps and digit growth never resize the slider track. (5) scripts/dev-server.py serves the root with no-store caching.
fields.verify: npm test (controls.test.js: parseTyped / typedHint / drag scheduler with fake timers); browser: type 12abc or clear a field → red field + hint, model unchanged; Enter valid → commits; Escape/blur invalid → reverts; slider track width constant during drag

Generator src/points/rhombicosidodeca.js (one permutation parity of (±1,±1,±φ³), (±φ²,±φ,±2φ), (±(2+φ),0,±φ²); the mirror of cyclic so pentagon normals coincide with icosahedronVerts' 5-fold axes and square normals with the icosidodecahedron's vertex directions). data.title: Fix rounding on subdivided and smoothed meshes

fields.actions: Review the Smooth × Rounding math on subdivided meshes and fix the shell-stage breakage. Findings: (1) Stage-2 face rings carried only two points per internal seam, so subdivided faces had 3–7-ray openings — fillets became bare triangles/chords, volume rose with rounding; (2) Smooth turns every sub-facet crease into a dihedral, and at low Smooth the rolling-ball strips are micrometres wide — their caps collapse to zero area in float32 and compile throws. Fix in src/solid/edgeround.js: lengthwise sampling along internal seams (shared per seam), a scale-relative strip-width floor (1e-3·R) so shallow creases stay sharp, one merge tolerance for strip ends/corner points, flat wedge caps for pinched corners and corners with sharp spokes, a mitre ribbon for knees (parent edge bent at a subdivision midpoint), and reuse of the strip end when a macro boundary runs straight through a corner.

data.title: Add dual operator to the distort chain

fields.actions: Polar dual about the origin (face plane n.x = d becomes vertex n/d, re-hull with coplanar merge, renormalize). New canonical state key dual (boolean, default false). Order: jitter -> dual -> truncate -> spike -> subdivide. Roadmap lists dual as the open skeleton operator; truncate's re-hull is the template. Tests, acceptance case, docs.

comments.author: claude
comments.body: Done in the working tree on main, uncommitted (2026-09-19). src/dual.js: polar reciprocation (face plane n.x=d -> vertex n/d), re-hull with coplanar merge always on, renormalize to unit circumradius. Canonical key dual (boolean, default false) in STATE_KEYS between jitterMode and truncate; pipeline order jitter -> dual -> truncate -> spike -> subdivide; Shape-panel Off/On control; start thumbnails keyed on it; SKELETON_KEYS includes it so edits re-run adaptation. main.js now catches a validation error from the edit-time limits probe (covers a folding Spike too). Tests (test/dual.test.js): classic pairs, Catalan rhombic duals, involution, exact planarity, three-valent corners so Truncate is exact, order vs Truncate, hash back-compat, composition matrix. Fuzz: 2000 jittered shapes (8 bases x 25 seeds x jitter 0-50 x 2 modes) with dual + ellipse all compiled, none threw. Acceptance: icosidodeca_dual, random_s1337_j10_dual_ellipse, twistedglobe_dual_t24_ellipse all ok.

data.title: Round the parent macro graph under Smooth instead of its facets

fields.actions: Smooth (skeleton-stage rolling-ball projection) and Rounding (shell-stage strips) implement the same fillet twice; Stage-2 currently fillets every sub-facet crease Smooth leaves. Unite facets by parent tag in solid/macro-topo.js regardless of coplanarity, so Rounding follows only parent dihedrals, and generalize the knee ribbon in solid/edgeround.js into a proper mitre for bent macro edges. Also consider the Stage-1 rim-arc direction (toward the origin, not the face normal), which skews rim roundovers on off-axis micro faces.
